base: Use case: logo-brand / identity-preserve. The attached image is the REQUIRED CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE, not a layout to copy. Create ONE original polished game LOGO emblem featuring EXACTLY THESE TWO EXISTING GAME CHARACTERS together. Preserve their distinctive identity, heads, facial style and costumes: MALE Xiao Jie has chunky chestnut brown spiky hair, large dark bronze-gray goggles resting on his forehead, expressive brown eyes, a bright red scarf/hood, red-and-dark tactical jacket, brown backpack straps and chunky dark armor. FEMALE Xiao Kui has a voluminous hot pink high ponytail and pink fringe, pink-lens black goggles on forehead, black round over-ear tactical headphones with pink rings, large expressive eyes, black outfit with vivid pink accents and fingerless gloves. Both are the recognizable stylized chibi game characters in the provided reference, NOT generic soldiers, NOT realistic adults, NOT replacement faces. Their compact angular gray futuristic guns should match the reference, with orange accent for the male and pink accent for the female. Reinterpret faithfully as an expertly designed flat graphic character emblem, confident clean contours, limited layered cel shading, selective negative space, strong silhouette, character heads large enough to read, mostly head and upper body, tightly interlocking shapes. Use the characters' actual brown/red and pink/black identity colors, with warm sand-gold #f8c976 and ivory graphic framing on flat deep midnight navy #10232d background. Square image, one centered cohesive symbol, generous margins. Sophisticated original visual design, not a screenshot cutout, not two unrelated character stickers, not a detailed poster. Aim for iconic, compact, usable gaming brand identity. NO text, NO letters, NO A, NO wordmark, NO digits, NO Chinese characters, NO watermark. Remove ALL reference UI labels, desert floor, crates and background. No realistic violence, no blood, no injured characters.

variants.name: 07-xiaojie-xiaokui-forward
variants.detail: COMPOSITION 1: FORWARD STRIKE DUO. Male on the front-right and female on the rear-left, both clearly visible, in a tightly composed three-quarter forward attack stance, aiming their compact guns out toward the viewer. Use controlled barrel foreshortening so their expressive eyes, male goggles/red scarf and female pink ponytail/headphones remain recognizable. Tie their shoulders and gun silhouettes into ONE dynamic diagonally ascending emblem, surrounded by a spare broken sand-gold scope ring. One tiny stylized gold muzzle flash for a sense of forward shooting. Friendly heroic chibi energy and decisive action, exceptional logo composition.

variants.name: 08-xiaojie-xiaokui-duel
variants.detail: COMPOSITION 2: FACE-OFF DUEL. Build a distinctive compact two-rival emblem: male from the left facing right, female from the right facing left, both in expressive three-quarter profile, their compact guns aiming toward the small central open gap. Both faces clearly visible, maintain their specific reference identities and chibi proportions. Opposing shoulder diagonals create a clever shared diamond-shaped negative space around a tiny gold crosshair. Use a restrained angular hexagonal sand-gold frame to unify the two fighters, mirrored dynamic energy with asymmetry from the pink ponytail and male red scarf. One strong, original logo badge, no central letter.

variants.name: 09-xiaojie-xiaokui-cover
variants.detail: COMPOSITION 3: BACK-TO-BACK SQUAD. Both reference characters back to back with large recognizable heads and shoulders: male turned three-quarter toward the left aiming his compact gun forward-left, female turned three-quarter toward the right aiming hers forward-right. Their backs and gear share a central seam to make a single cohesive silhouette. Sweep the female's vivid pink ponytail upward-right and male red scarf outward-left as balanced graphic countershapes. Integrate their lower upper-body shapes into a minimal sand-gold shield base and a sparse open sight ring. Energetic cooperative shooting and mutual cover, a sophisticated tightly constructed original emblem, not a generic esports animal logo.
